plainText:
Volume 25 is the twenty-fifth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the fourth of five volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto. 

==Blurb==
One of Team Rocket’s Three Beasts turns against their leader Giovanni and seeks to usurp his power. Silver learns a shocking secret about his family. Red and Mewtwo hazard a daring escape. And—whoa! The Team Rocket airship is about to crash-land!

Then, in a battle between powerful Legendary Pokémon Mewtwo and Mythical Pokémon Deoxys, who will triumph...?!

==Important events==
 
Carr attempts, and fails, to usurp the leadership of Team Rocket.
is freed from its armor.
and receive their new Pokédexes.
is revealed to be 's father. Sird and Orm kidnap Silver in order to take him to their leader.
Red and Mewtwo battle Giovanni and on top the Team Rocket airship.
Silver finds out who his father is.
reaches the airship.
heads towards Kanto.
Mewtwo defeats Deoxys.
The Kanto region's climate is restored.
It is revealed that there are two Deoxys organisms. The origins of the second organism are revealed.
The reason behind the kidnapping of Silver and by the Masked Man is revealed.
Carr attempts to kill everyone on board the airship.
Sird manages to stabilize the airship.
tells the rest of 's history. 
helps acknowledge that is his father. 
Red gives Yellow his old Pokédex. 
Organism No. 2 goes off to find Organism No. 1. Sird tries to capture it. 
Red, Blue, , Yellow, and Silver are turned to stone. 

==Party changes==
===Additions===
None.
===Evolutions===
Green's "Jiggly" evolves into in PS288.
Green's evolves into in PS288.
Green's "Nido" evolves into in PS288.

==Trivia==
This issue has connecting cover art with the previous two volumes.
Yellow is called Yellow of Viridian Forest rather than Amarillo del Bosque Verde.

===Errors===
Ultima is strangely called Kimberly a few times throughout the volume and by Professor Oak when they witness the Dexholder's petrification.
